name: sled vertical leg press
description: A leg press on a sled that moves straight up, pressing the weight vertically. It loads the thighs and glutes heavily.
instructions: Lie on your back under the sled and place your feet shoulder-width on the platform.
Release the safety catches and lower the platform until your knees are deeply bent.
Keep your lower back flat on the pad.
Press the platform up without locking your knees.
Lower under control for each rep.
